Strategy: Pair items on a log scale. Prefer a bin whose leftover is near the item size, measuring closeness in logarithms, so very loose bins are barely punished while tight ones still matter. Score by log distance from a leftover of one item, exact fits tied at the top, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin near the pairing point. It may help by tolerating roomy bins, but may fail by letting loose bins win too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(log(r - item + 1) - log(item + 1))) + (log(item + 1) if r - item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Log pairing distance: score by -abs(log(leftover+1)-log(item+1)), exact fits tied at top.
